# Daily X Report — 2026-11-15

Three threads today: the Nvidia saga escalated from reports on Jensen Huang's resignation to US Congress preparing tighter AI chip export controls; crypto sold off hard over the weekend, with Bitcoin falling to just above $63,000, a three-month low; and AI/world models kept shipping, with DeepMind's Gemini 4 Hydrogen and Runway's open-source action model Praxis-1 leading the way.

## 1. AI Practical / Agents

### 1. DeepMind launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen
Built for fast coding, multimodal synthesis and everyday workflows; 2.5x faster than 3.8 Flash at task completion and ahead of Argon on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, with head-to-head benchmarks vs Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Terra — the day's biggest model news.
https://x.com/GoogleDeepMind/status/2120940338869055788

### 2. Anthropic announces its IPO
Anthropic announced its initial public offering, linking to ipo.anthropic.com with an SEC registration notice; an AI lab going public is a major industry and market signal and a starting point for tracking its valuation and governance.
https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2120841731302154708

### 3. ChatGPT Businesses enters beta
Businesses can claim their listings, see customer interaction insights, and eligible businesses can build a Business Agent to answer customer questions — a key step in ChatGPT's push into merchant-side AI agents, worth watching for its effect on search and local business traffic.
https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2120216592395174382

### 4. Anthropic's 10 recommendations for safety evaluations
Safety evaluations decide whether a model can ship, what safeguards it needs and where training should focus; the engineering blog's 10 recommendations on designing, running and reporting evaluations are a public methodology summary with direct value for anyone doing model evals and safety governance.
https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2121317227618340990

## 2. AI Video / World Models

### 5. Runway launches open-source action model Praxis-1
An open-source action model for interactive world models and real-world intelligence, trained on thousands of community datasets under Apache 2.0 — a notable step for embodied AI, with an open license that makes reproduction and further work easier.
https://x.com/runwayml/status/2120533081182577116

### 6. Praxis-1 now runs on the SO-101 robot
Praxis-1 now runs on the SO-101 robot, trained on thousands of LeRobot community datasets and runnable on a single RTX 5090 with NVFP4; checkpoints and setup instructions are public — the open action model moving from demo to real robot hardware.
https://x.com/runwayml/status/2121252482454335530

### 7. Runway launches 3D generation model Tripo H3.1
Billed as the "world's first 3D generation model", it produces higher-fidelity 3D assets at lower cost, with examples; 3D asset generation is an important direction alongside video and world models, worth comparing with peers.
https://x.com/runwayml/status/2120883301833400668

## 3. Finance & Markets

### 8. US Congress prepares tighter AI chip export controls
Per the FT, Congress is preparing stricter AI chip export controls after the Nvidia scandal: several bills would curb sales of sensitive chips abroad and give Congress power to review and potentially block sales already approved by the Trump administration, with bipartisan support — the day's most-watched market and policy signal.
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2121940650245398975

### 9. Bitcoin falls to just above $63,000, a three-month low
Crypto sold off hard over the weekend, with Bitcoin dropping to just above $63,000, a three-month low, as leveraged longs were liquidated — mainstream confirmation of the break below a key level and the liquidation wave.
https://x.com/business/status/2121765138575290522

### 10. WaPo cited: Rubio said to have driven events leading to Huang's resignation
Citing the Washington Post, the events leading to Jensen Huang's resignation last week were reportedly "driven" by Secretary of State Rubio, including a memo to Trump based on a CIA report, the memo's leak, and Huang resigning six days after the leak — the day's biggest breaking markets/tech personnel lead, but second-hand and unverified, needing cross-checking.
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2121714283603443920

### 11. S&P 500 energy up 50% in 196 trading days, a historic pace
The S&P 500 energy sector gained 50% this year in just 196 trading days, the fifth-fastest such run for any sector since 1990 — a concise data point framing how rare this energy rally is, useful for reading sector rotation.
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2121781479910883578

# 今日推特精选报告（2026-11-15）

今日主线有三条：一是英伟达风波持续发酵，从黄仁勋辞职的幕后说法升级为美国国会拟收紧 AI 芯片出口管制；二是加密市场周末急跌，比特币跌至略高于 63,000 美元的三个月低点；三是 AI 模型与世界模型继续密集发布，DeepMind 的 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 与 Runway 的开源动作模型 Praxis-1 各有新进展。

## 一、AI 实用 / Agent

### 1. DeepMind 发布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen
面向快速编码、多模态合成与日常工作流，任务完成速度为 3.8 Flash 的 2.5 倍，并在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数上超越 Argon；附与 Claude Sonnet 5.5、GPT-6.1 Terra 的横向基准，是当日最重要的模型新闻之一。
https://x.com/GoogleDeepMind/status/2120940338869055788

### 2. Anthropic 宣布首次公开募股（IPO）
宣布首次公开募股，链接至 ipo.anthropic.com，并附 SEC 注册声明的法律提示；AI 实验室走向上市是重要的行业与市场信号，可作为追踪其估值与治理变化的起点。
https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2120841731302154708

### 3. ChatGPT Businesses 功能进入测试版
企业可认领商家信息、查看用户互动洞察，符合条件的企业还能搭建 Business Agent 回答顾客问题；这是 ChatGPT 向商家端和 AI 智能体落地的关键一步，值得关注其对搜索与本地商业流量的影响。
https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2120216592395174382

### 4. Anthropic 安全评估 10 条建议
安全评估对判断模型能否部署、应建何种保障及训练重点至关重要，工程博客给出设计、执行与报告评估的 10 条建议；这是 Anthropic 公开的方法论总结，对做模型评测与安全治理的读者有直接参考价值。
https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2121317227618340990

## 二、AI 视频 / 世界模型

### 5. Runway 推出开源动作模型 Praxis-1
面向交互式世界模型与现实世界智能的开源动作模型，基于数千个社区数据集训练，采用 Apache 2.0 许可；开源世界动作模型是具身智能方向的重要进展，开放许可也便于复现与二次开发。
https://x.com/runwayml/status/2120533081182577116

### 6. Praxis-1 登陆 SO-101 机器人
Praxis-1 现已可在 SO-101 机器人上运行，基于 LeRobot 社区数千个数据集训练，单张 RTX 5090（NVFP4）即可跑，检查点与安装说明已公开；开源动作模型从演示走向真实机器人硬件，是具身智能方向的可复现实操进展。
https://x.com/runwayml/status/2121252482454335530

### 7. Runway 推出 3D 生成模型 Tripo H3.1
号称“全球首个 3D 生成模型”，能以比以往更低的成本生成更高保真度的 3D 资产，附带示例；3D 资产生成是视频与世界模型之外的重要方向，值得与同类工具横向比较。
https://x.com/runwayml/status/2120883301833400668

## 三、金融与市场

### 8. 美国国会拟收紧 AI 芯片出口管制
据 FT 消息，美国国会正准备在英伟达风波后通过更严格的 AI 芯片出口管制，多项法案拟限制敏感芯片对外销售，并赋予国会审查甚至否决已获特朗普政府批准销售的权力，两党均表支持；芯片出口管制升级是当日最受关注的市场与政策信号。
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2121940650245398975

### 9. 比特币跌至略高于 63,000 美元的三个月低点
加密货币周末大跌，比特币跌至略高于 63,000 美元的三个月低点，杠杆多头仓位被清算；主流财经媒体对比特币跌破关键价位与清算的确认性报道，适合作为市场动态的基准来源。
https://x.com/business/status/2121765138575290522

### 10. 援引《华盛顿邮报》：鲁比奥被指推动导致黄仁勋辞职的一系列事件
援引《华盛顿邮报》称，上周导致黄仁勋辞职的一系列事件由美国国务卿鲁比奥“推动”，包括其依据 CIA 报告发备忘录提醒特朗普、备忘录内容被泄露、黄仁勋在泄露 6 天后辞职；当日最重磅的突发市场/科技人事线索，但仅为转述说法，未独立核实，需交叉验证。
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2121714283603443920

### 11. 标普 500 能源板块 196 个交易日涨 50%，创历史速度
能源股正在创造历史，标普 500 能源板块仅用 196 个交易日年内上涨 50%，为 1990 年以来各板块达成该里程碑的第五快速度；用历史数据框定本轮能源行情的罕见程度，是理解板块轮动的简明数据点。
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2121781479910883578
